description:
List malformed participant identifiers

The individual identifiers that failed their scheme's structural rule, keyset-paginated on (scheme, value). The first page's `meta.facets` gives scheme and reason counts over the filtered set.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `next_cursor` by the previous page.

limit.description: Page size, clamped to [1, 200]. Defaults to 50.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the identifier value.

reason.description: Filter by the kind of structural failure.

scheme.description: Filter to one Peppol ICD scheme (e.g. `0208`).

smp.description: Filter to malformed ids homed on one SMP hostname (from `meta.facets.smp`).

name: list_id_quality_malformed
